description: This file defines a React component for exploring multiverse paths in a career navigator app. It includes UI components for listing paths, roles, bookmarks, and details, and manages complex state related to path selection, bookmarking, and role recommendations.

methods.name: roleIdFromRec
methods.description: Extracts an ID string from a role recommendation object, using various possible fields or defaulting to a generated ID.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRec
methods.description: Derives the role title string from a recommendation object.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given multiverse path type.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a description of what each path type entails.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a string value is a valid MultiversePathType.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Filters paths based on search query, industry, and skills.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Converts raw backend bookmark records into local bookmark objects, sorted by creation date.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendedRoles
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of recommended role objects with relevant properties.
